target_customer: Urban consumers in New York wanting on-demand laundry and dry cleaning pickup and delivery
problem: Dropping off and collecting laundry and dry cleaning is a time consuming errand with fixed store hours.
business_model: On-demand consumer service charging per order, using partner cleaners then vertical integration

founders.name: Tom Harari
previous_startups: REGENT (W21 founding team, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Marketing, growth and design skills per YC page.

founders.name: Itay Forer
founders.background_notes: Says he helped scale a company from 3 to 400+ people (YC page).

competitors.name: FlyCleaners
competitors.what: On-demand laundry startup rolling out in Brooklyn

competitors.name: Rinse
competitors.what: San Francisco on-demand dry cleaning and laundry

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile ordering and routing software on top of partner cleaners; the hard part was logistics and unit economics, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals launched the same service within a year or two (Washio, FlyCleaners, Rinse, Prim), so copying was easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Washio shut down in August 2016 and Rinse bought its assets; Prim also shut down in 2016. Cleanly survived, went profitable in 2016 per Vator, and merged with NextCleaners.

market_need_then: Venture funded on-demand laundry players launched in 2013 to 2015 in New York and San Francisco, showing investor belief in demand for pickup and delivery.

branding.domain_note: cleanly.com was registered in 2004 per a WHOIS listing and was used by the company; how it was acquired is not stated. It now redirects to bynext.co.

identity.voice_and_tone: Convenience focused: delivery at the tap of a button

rebrands.why: Merged with NextCleaners under the new name By Next

brand_strength.rationale: Clear descriptive name, but no sourced brand assets or community, and the brand was folded into ByNext.

pivots.to: Vertical integration through acquiring plants and cleaners
pivots.why: Cleanly bought The Dhobi and Do Laundry For Me per a 2017-05 press release; merged with NextCleaners later.

outcome_analysis: Cleanly raised a 2.3 million dollar seed in 2015 and a 5 million dollar Series A in 2017 and reported profitability in 2016, while rivals like Washio and Prim shut down. It vertically integrated by acquiring local laundries and then merged all-stock with NextCleaners to form ByNext, so the outcome was a merger with undisclosed terms rather than a clear exit or failure. The company brand was absorbed into the larger entity.
notes: Directory status is Active, but the company merged into ByNext (CB Insights dates the merger to March 2020, another source says late February; year only recorded). Total raised conflicts: 8.8M (company release 2017), over 7M, over 15M (merger release). The cleanly.com redirect to bynext.co was seen directly but I did not open the destination. Competitor funding is from articles dated 2013 to 2015.
